main_body: Hospital bed seen from above: grey headboard with dark bars at the top, a white pillow, a white sheet, and a blue blanket running down a tall narrow rectangle.
top_band: Column from row 11: light grey rim (rows 11-12), then headboard bars (13-19), dark band (20-22), then the pillow and sheet (22-44). There is no distinct foreshortened top band over a separate front face.
evidence: The mattress, pillow and blanket fill about 25 rows as a flat plan of the bed, seen from straight above. The only vertical face is the small headboard at the top, and the footboard at rows 44-47 is a thin dark strip. No south-facing front face sits below a foreshortened top surface, so this matches the top-down slab in the guide, not a 3/4 object.

style.evidence: The white sheet and pillow are large, nearly flat fills with only one or two grey shades. The blue blanket has about 3 steps. The grey frame is flat with a dark, nearly neutral outline. Compared with the stall and well references, which have per-tile highlights, grain and many tones, it has much less texture and fewer colours per tile.
